# Toast

A brief, transient confirmation that an action finished ("Set saved"), with at most one action such as Undo.

`SongNodes.Toast` · Feedback

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.Toast />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.Toast"></x-import>
```

## Props (ToastProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `queueLimit` | `3` | Queue manager: shows one toast at a time, keeps at most 3 waiting (oldest dropped). |
| `placement` | `"auto"` | Placement: bottom centre, bottom right from the desktop breakpoint. |
| `toast` | `(options: ToastOptions) => void` | Push a toast; never for errors that need action (use Banner, ErrorState or InlineMessage). |

### ToastOptions

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `message` * | `ReactNode` | Past-tense confirmation: "Set saved", "Tracklist copied: 18 tracks". |
| `action` | `{ label: string; onAction: () => void }` | One optional action, usually Undo; must also be available elsewhere (e.g. Ctrl/Cmd+Z, history). |
| `durationMs` | `number` | Visible time in ms: default 4000, 8000 with an action. Pauses on hover and focus. |
